title: policy.json: tiers
description: Who executes each sizing tier, with which model class and effort (design part 5.1). Model classes name roles, not models; the harness adapter maps them (the milestone Model catalog refines this).

0.description: The orchestrator, inline: a handful of tool calls.

1.description: A background agent: mechanical, fully specified work.

2.description: A background agent: implementation inside a known design.

3.description: Its own session: design-heavy, risky or long work, or work the owner reviews in person.

runs_as.description: Who runs an item of this tier: the orchestrator inline, a background agent, or its own session.
